description: A plot of values over two axes: curves, live traces, lines, bands, a grid with its labels, dots and draggable handles with a native input each, and a cursor that reads the value under the pointer. Its svelte adapter.

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** A stretch of the plot between two values on one axis. Style its `fill`. */
let { ...rest }: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Band>, "children"> = $props();
</script>

<parts.Band {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <rect height={state.height} width={state.width} x={state.x} y={state.y} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Band>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Path from "./Path.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** A curve across the plot: `y = fn(x)` in the axes' units. Style its `stroke` and `fill`. */
let {
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Curve>, "children"> = $props();
</script>

<parts.Curve {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Path d={state.d} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Curve>

{#snippet children( state )} {#each state.columns as tick (`x-${tick.value}`)} {#if tick.label !== null}
{tick.label}
{/if} {/each} {#each state.rows as tick (`y-${tick.value}`)} {#if tick.label !== null}
{tick.label}
{/if} {/each} {/snippet}

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
import type { GridTick } from "@audio-ui/primitives/plot";

let { columns, rows }: { columns: GridTick[]; rows: GridTick[] } = $props();
</script>

{#each columns as tick (`x-${tick.value}`)}
  <line
    data-axis="x"
    data-part="line"
    data-zero={tick.value === 0 ? "" : undefined}
    style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke"
    x1={tick.position}
    x2={tick.position}
    y1={0}
    y2={1}
  />
{/each}
{#each rows as tick (`y-${tick.value}`)}
  <line
    data-axis="y"
    data-part="line"
    data-zero={tick.value === 0 ? "" : undefined}
    style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke"
    x1={0}
    x2={1}
    y1={1 - tick.position}
    y2={1 - tick.position}
  />
{/each}

<script lang="ts">
import type { HandleState } from "@audio-ui/primitives/plot";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/**
 * A point on the plot that can be moved, in the axes' units, with a native
 * `<input type="range">` for each axis it moves along carrying the names.
 */
let {
  "aria-label": label,
  axis = "both",
  children: content,
  getAriaLabel,
  getAriaValueText,
  handle,
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Handle>, "aria-label" | "children"> & {
  "aria-label"?: string;
  children?: Snippet<[HandleState]>;
  /** Names each axis input. Defaults to `aria-label`, followed by "X" or "Y" when the handle moves along both. */
  getAriaLabel?: (axis: "x" | "y") => string | undefined;
  /** Returns an axis input's `aria-valuetext`, from its value. */
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, axis: "x" | "y") => string;
} = $props();

const nameOf = (along: "x" | "y") =>
  getAriaLabel?.(along) ??
  (label && axis === "both" ? `${label} ${along.toUpperCase()}` : label);
</script>

<parts.Handle {...rest} {axis} {handle}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {@render content?.(state)}
    {#if axis !== "y"}
      <parts.InputX getAriaLabel={nameOf} {getAriaValueText} {handle} />
    {/if}
    {#if axis !== "x"}
      <parts.InputY getAriaLabel={nameOf} {getAriaValueText} {handle} />
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Handle>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** A straight line across the plot at a value. Style its `stroke`. */
let { ...rest }: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Line>, "children"> = $props();
</script>

<parts.Line {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <line
      style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke"
      x1={state.x1}
      x2={state.x2}
      y1={state.y1}
      y2={state.y2}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Line>

<svelte:options namespace="svg" />

<script lang="ts">
let { d }: { d: string } = $props();
</script>

<path {d} data-plot="path" style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke" />

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import Path from "./Path.svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts.ts";

/** A live line across the plot, drawn straight in the DOM from a source. Style its `stroke` and `fill`. */
let {
  ...rest
}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Trace>, "children"> = $props();
</script>

<parts.Trace {...rest}>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    <Path d={state.d} />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Trace>
